binding_rules: project_id la khoa tu nhien rang buoc (UK dim_project_profile). project_key la khoa thay the co dinh theo bang duoi.
Moi thanh vien CHI duoc sinh khoa trong dai cua minh; tuyet doi khong tai su dung khoa ngoai dai.
Mot du an = mot project_key duy nhat. Cac phase/toa thap con nam duoi project_key do bang zone_key, KHONG tao them project_key.
unit_code = <prefix> + so thu tu zero-pad theo unit_code_width (vi du OCP-U00001).
Snapshot block ap dung bat bien cho ca 5 pack; moi phep tinh DOM can cu snapshot_date.
